conversations.notice: Status reflects the latest run. Times are UTC. Completed message models take priority; request snapshots and legacy inference audits are evidence-based fallbacks. Tokens sum all retained completed model messages, including tool loops, excluding classifier/title/compaction and nested tool model usage. Missing history is not estimated as zero. Records are removed with the conversation and are not an immutable bill.

tokenStatistics.note: Totals use retained message.completed official totalTokens only. Missing usage is —; cache and reasoning are not added again. Classification, titles, compaction and nested tools are excluded. Active users and conversations are distinct users and chats with completed messages in the period. Dates use database natural days. Departments and roles reflect current membership, not historical snapshots; multiple roles count once as a combination. Changes compare the previous equal period, with no percentage for zero or unrecorded baselines.

roleWorkspace.quotaRules: Shared by current role members, using retained completed-message totalTokens, not per-person limits. Days and months reset in database time. Any exceeded blocking role stops the run. Checked before startup and after persisting each completed message, then abort is requested. In-flight and concurrent calls may overshoot; per-task limits are not hard request budgets. Missing usage, titles, classification and nested tools are excluded. Warnings go to server logs. Restore defaults removes quota limits.
